Committee: Commerce and Small Business
Sponsor: Lee
Analyst: JT Mathis
Date: 02/15/2022
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 305 as introduced could reduce business license fee collections to municipalities by an undetermined amount dependent on the amount of business license fees currently collected by a municipality from businesses located in other jurisdictions that provide lease or rental services in the municipality.
Jim Carns, Chair
Commerce and Small Business

Committee: Commerce and Small Business
Sponsor: Lee
Analyst: JT Mathis
Date: 02/16/2022
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 305 as substituted and reported by the Committee on Commerce and Small Business could increase business license fee collections to municipalities by an undetermined amount dependent on the additional amount of business license fees collected by a municipality from businesses located in other jurisdictions that provide lease or rental services in the municipality.
Jim Carns, Chair
Commerce and Small Business

Committee: Fiscal Responsibility and Economic Development
Sponsor: Lee
Analyst: JT Mathis
Date: 03/01/2022
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 305 as passed the House of Representatives could increase business license fee collections to municipalities by an undetermined amount dependent on the additional amount of business license fees collected by a municipality from businesses located in other jurisdictions that provide lease or rental services in the municipality.
Steve Livingston, Chairperson
Fiscal Responsibility and Economic Development
